# tinystyle

> Tiny CSS library for plain, semantic HTML. Elements look finished without classes. Variants are
> `data-*` attributes with fixed values. Light and dark mode switch automatically.

This is the short version: enough for small edits. Before building whole pages or migrating, read
`llms-full.txt` in the same folder: every attribute in detail, all tokens, and copy-paste recipes
(form, card, dialog, toolbar, status, settings rows, app shell, dropdown, card grid, label/value pairs).

## Setup

```js
import '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/core.css';   // always
import '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/app.css';    // app shell, navigation rail, floating action button
import '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/menu.css';   // dropdown menus
import '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/icons.css';  // the default icon set (see Icons)
// or everything: import '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/all.css';
```

```js
// vite.config.js: runs tinystyle check in every build (errors fail the build, the dev server warns)
import tinystyle from '@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle/vite';
export default { plugins: [tinystyle()] };
// with icons: every Lucide icon by name (only the used ones are emitted) plus your own SVG folder
// export default { plugins: [tinystyle({ icons: { dir: 'src/icons' } })] };  and  import 'virtual:tinystyle-icons.css';
// while migrating step by step, check only the migrated parts: tinystyle({ paths: ['src/contacts', 'contacts'] })
```

## Rules

1. Write semantic HTML first. `button`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `label`, `fieldset`, `dialog`,
   `[popover]`, `details`, `table`, `article` (card), `dl`, `progress`, `code`, `kbd` are styled
   without any attributes.
2. Use HTML and ARIA state, not attributes of your own: `disabled`, `aria-busy="true"` (spinner),
   `aria-invalid="true"` (error border), `aria-pressed="true"` (toggled), `aria-current`.
3. Variants are the `data-*` attributes listed below, with exactly the listed values. Each attribute
   is one independent axis: `data-variant` is the style, `data-tone` is the color, `data-size` is the
   size. Do not invent classes or values for these.
4. **Spacing:** nothing has an outer margin. The parent owns all space: `data-gap` between its
   children (needs `data-layout`), `data-pad` around them. Do not write `margin` or `padding` in
   `style` attributes. To add space between two things, wrap them in a `data-layout` element.
   `data-layout` overrides an element's own display, so `<label data-layout="row">` is a real row.
   `data-grow` on one child makes it take the remaining space (search fields, inputs next to a button).
5. Sizes always use the same words: `xs sm md lg xl`. There are no numeric scales.
6. Your own CSS always wins over tinystyle (tinystyle lives in `@layer ts.*`). Never use `!important`.
   In your own CSS, use the tokens (`var(--ts-text-muted)`, `var(--ts-space-sm)`), never hard-coded colors.
7. Use `class` only for your app's own components. `data-*` attributes from the list below belong to
   tinystyle; do not use those names for anything else.
8. Size and tune things with the documented custom properties in `style` (`style="--ts-min: 12rem"`,
   `style="--ts-tone: #e8590c"`, `style="--ts-avatar-size: 4rem"`). That is the intended way; do not
   write `width`, `margin` or `padding` there.
9. Run `npx tinystyle check <dir>` after editing (or use the Vite plugin, which runs it in every build).
   It reports unknown attribute values and tokens, and unlabeled icon or close buttons.
10. To see the result, prefer `npx tinystyle-inspect <dev-server-url>` (package
    `@tiaforge-ui/tinystyle-inspect`, if installed) over screenshots. It opens every dialog and popover
    at a wide and a narrow width, in light and dark mode, and reports overflow, misplaced overlays,
    contrast, unlabeled controls and covered click targets as text. To judge how it looks, add
    `--sheet <dir>`: it writes one image per page with every state at every width and scheme, so one
    look replaces a dozen screenshots.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `data-variant` | secondary, outline, ghost, link | Button style; leave it out for the solid main button. |
| `data-tone` | accent, neutral, danger, success, warning, info | Color, independent of the style; for any other color use style="--ts-tone: …". |
| `data-size` | sm, md, lg | Control size relative to the current density. |
| `data-icon` | an icon name (see Icons), or none | Icon by Lucide name; an empty button with it is a square icon-only button (needs aria-label). |
| `data-layout` | stack, row, grid, split, center | Lays out the element's children (overrides its own display). |
| `data-gap` | none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl | Space between the children of a data-layout element. |
| `data-pad` | none, xs, sm, md, lg, xl | Padding inside the element, on all sides. |
| `data-align` | start, center, end, stretch | Cross-axis alignment of children (align-items). |
| `data-justify` | start, center, end, between | Main-axis distribution of children (justify-content). |
| `data-self` | start, center, end, stretch | Aligns this one child (e.g. data-self="start" keeps a button in a stack from stretching). |
| `data-wrap` | wrap, none | Whether a row wraps onto more lines. |
| `data-grow` | (boolean) | This child takes the remaining space in its row or stack. |
| `data-scroll` | (boolean) | Scrolls its content sideways when it is wider than the screen, instead of making the whole page scroll. |
| `data-density` | comfortable, compact | Control height and padding for everything inside. |
| `data-theme` | light, dark | Forces light or dark mode. |
| `data-badge` | (boolean) | Small status label (counts, tags, states). |
| `data-callout` | (boolean) | Tinted message box. |
| `data-muted` | (boolean) | Secondary text color. |
| `data-truncate` | (boolean) | Single line, cut off with an ellipsis. |
| `data-sr-only` | (boolean) | Hidden visually, still read by screen readers. |
| `data-pairs` | (boolean) | Shows dt/dd pairs as a two-column label/value grid. |
| `data-caption` | (boolean) | Small, semibold, muted label text: captions above values, group headings like a letter in an index. |
| `data-avatar` | (boolean) | Round avatar with initials, or an <img> child that fills it. |
| `data-stretch` | (boolean) | Makes the whole card clickable through this element. |
| `data-shell` (app.css) | (boolean) | App shell: a navigation rail ([data-rail]) next to <main>. |
| `data-rail` (app.css) | (boolean) | Navigation rail next to <main>; with popover it is a drawer on narrow screens. |
| `data-collapsed` (app.css) | (boolean) | Icon-only rail, set in the markup (e.g. |
| `data-rail-collapse` (app.css) | (boolean) | Collapse toggle drawn as a chevron icon button. |
| `data-rail-label` (app.css) | (boolean) | Hidden while the rail is collapsed (e.g. |
| `data-fab` (app.css) | (boolean) | Floating action button fixed in the bottom-right corner. |
| `data-show` (app.css) | narrow, wide | Shows the element only on narrow (< 48rem) or wide screens. |
| `data-menu` (menu.css) | (boolean) | Menu of buttons, links and checkbox labels; as a [popover] it opens under its button. |

## Tokens

Set inputs on `:root` in your own CSS to change the theme. Use the rest in your own CSS.

- Inputs (set these): `--ts-hue`, `--ts-chroma`, `--ts-neutral-hue`, `--ts-neutral-tint`, `--ts-primary`, `--ts-radius`, `--ts-badge-radius`, `--ts-font-sans`, `--ts-font-mono`, `--ts-heading-weight`, `--ts-heading-tracking`, `--ts-duration`, `--ts-ease`, `--ts-min`, `--ts-split`, `--ts-measure`, `--ts-dialog-width`, `--ts-avatar-size`, `--ts-rail-width`, `--ts-rail-width-collapsed`, `--ts-grow-basis`, `--ts-icon-<name>`
- Colors: `--ts-bg`, `--ts-surface`, `--ts-surface-raised`, `--ts-fill`, `--ts-field`, `--ts-field-border`, `--ts-border`, `--ts-border-strong`, `--ts-text`, `--ts-text-muted`, `--ts-accent`, `--ts-neutral`, `--ts-danger`, `--ts-success`, `--ts-warning`, `--ts-info`, `--ts-tone`, `--ts-tone-ink`, `--ts-tone-soft`, `--ts-tone-on`
- Space: `--ts-space-none`, `--ts-space-xs`, `--ts-space-sm`, `--ts-space-md`, `--ts-space-lg`, `--ts-space-xl`
- Radius: `--ts-radius-full`
- Text sizes: `--ts-text-xs`, `--ts-text-sm`, `--ts-text-md`, `--ts-text-lg`, `--ts-text-xl`
- Shadows: `--ts-shadow-sm`, `--ts-shadow-lg`

## Icons

```html
<span data-icon="mail"></span>                                        <!-- an icon, 1.125em, in the text color -->
<button data-icon="pencil">Edit</button>                              <!-- icon before the text -->
<button data-icon="x" data-variant="ghost" aria-label="Close"></button>  <!-- empty: square icon-only button, needs aria-label -->
<a href="/mail/" data-icon="mail"><span>Mail</span></a>               <!-- rail items, links -->
```

Names are Lucide's (https://lucide.dev/icons). icons.css contains: mail, inbox, send, calendar, calendar-plus, clock, users, user, user-plus, search, bell, settings, log-out, log-in, menu, plus, minus, x, check, pencil, trash-2, share-2, copy, download, upload, paperclip, link, external-link, star, heart, filter, refresh-cw, ellipsis, ellipsis-vertical, chevron-down, chevron-up, chevron-left, chevron-right, arrow-left, arrow-right, house, info, circle-alert, triangle-alert, circle-check, eye, eye-off, lock, map-pin, phone, archive, folder, file, image, sun, moon. With the Vite plugin's `icons` option every Lucide name works, and only the icons you
use end up in the CSS. Do not paste inline `<svg>` for an icon that has a name.

Icons are one color (the text color); keep multicolor logos as `<img>`.

## Anti-patterns

| Don't | Do |
|---|---|
| `<button class="secondary">` | `<button data-variant="secondary">` |
| `<button data-variant="danger">` | `<button data-tone="danger">` (tone is color, variant is style) |
| `<button data-variant="primary">` | `<button>` (primary is the default) |
| `<p class="error">` | `<p data-tone="danger">` or `<div data-callout data-tone="danger">` |
| `style="margin-top: 1rem"` on a button or input | wrap the elements in `data-layout="stack" data-gap="md"` |
| `style="padding: var(--ts-space-lg)"` | `data-pad="lg"` |
| a custom class to turn a `label` into a flex row | `<label data-layout="row" data-justify="between">` |
| `data-gap="4"` or `data-gap="16px"` | `data-gap="md"` |
| `<button data-icon="x"></button>` | `<button data-icon="x" aria-label="Close"></button>` |
| `<svg><path d="…"/></svg>` for a mail icon | `<span data-icon="mail"></span>` |
| `data-badge="true"` | `data-badge` |
| `color: #666` in app CSS | `color: var(--ts-text-muted)` |
| `!important` to beat tinystyle | a plain selector; app CSS already wins |
